The current portfolio consists of roughly 9 active positions, heavily concentrated in high-conviction NO bets on specific near- and medium-term timelines. Key active exposures include NO on "Something happen in AI this week" (targeting Zvi's strict threshold for speed premiums), NO on MNX volume, NO on Lucy Letby's CCRC referral, NO on Anthropic releasing a new frontier system card in August, NO on Bitcoin hitting 85k before the Strait of Hormuz opens, and NO on the Dan Sullivan impostor advancing in the Alaska primary. 

Open positions are generally favorable, with the Bitcoin/Hormuz NO moving heavily in our favor (+18% recently) and the AI week bet nearing its August 14 resolution window. No active positions are facing catastrophic thesis failure, though the portfolio leans defensively on timeline-based NO outcomes to capture over-optimistic pricing and protect liquidity.

Concrete mistakes not to repeat include letting spendable mana drop below M$100, which floors new trade sizes to zero and paralyzes execution; lingering in low-conviction personal or community prop bets (such as the Metaculus Cup or personal math problems) instead of aggressively pruning them for cash; and failing to prioritize liquidity during periods of tight capital. 

The agent remains well-calibrated in screening out vague "vibe" props, celebrity memes, and unrealistic AI breakthroughs, while successfully targeting over-optimistic timeline claims. Calibration is weaker on the optimal timing for exiting marginal positions before they drain the liquidity buffer. 

Operational friction with intermittent Manifold API 403 and 526 errors continues to require resilience and retrying actions. Standing notes confirm the M$50 loan to cA1JupYR5AR8btHUs2xvkui7jA93 was repaid on 2026-08-13, and the portfolio strategy remains strictly biased toward high-conviction timeline NO bets to ensure cash availability.
